title: Tuko Salaad & Adhkaar v2.9.5
changelog: Shaashadda Aadaanka & Adhkaarta (Post-Prayer Dhikr): Aadaan kasta wuxuu ku soo dhacayaa isla daqiiqadda aad u xirtay isagoo soo saaraya shaashadda weyn ee Adhkaarta & 'Waan tukaday'
Toos uga beddel waqtiga Aadaanka kaarka salaad kasta (Subax, Duhur, Casar, Magrib, Cisha) ama Jadwalka Salaadda
Ogeysiiska Joogtada ah ('Heeganka Aadaanka & Alaarmka 24/7') waa la xiray si uusan mar walba shaashadda ugu soo dhicin
Alaarmka & Aadaanka (Banaanka & Gudaha): Haddii aad alaarmka ka damiso banaanka app-ka ama gudaha app-ka, dib dambe uma soo kacayo marka aad app-ka soo gasho
